Appointments are pretty easy to get same day via the app and for an AMAB person the GPs seem pretty reasonable, although quite rushed with only 10 minutes per appointment by default (mostly I believe a symptom of the chronic understaffing issues, they have far too few doctors for the student population + local residents).

However, for mental health care *especially* for AFAB individuals you should strongly consider requesting support from a male friend to act as your chaperone and ensure you are not dismissed. I have seen GPs dismiss the issues of women before but it is on a unique level here, I've had friends come out of the room in tears because rather than approach the subject of mental health carefully they demanded an answer and refused to support them effectively, just upped their dosage and moved onto the next person because they were behind on appointments.
